next.reason: 1985: unequal-size operands are compared 'as though the shorter operand were extended on the right by sufficient spaces'. §2023:8.8.4.2.7 GR2: 'comparison proceeds as though the shorter operand were extended on the right by sufficient alphanumeric spaces', applied to group and alphabetic operands through §2023:8.8.4.2.1 GR13. Trailing-space truncation and EC-LOCALE-INCOMPATIBLE apply only to locale-based comparison, used only when the program collating sequence is locale based (§2023:8.8.4.2.7), which a 1985 program cannot specify; the national-space rule covers a 2023-only class.
